i.norm: Verifies the MRA encoding of a string that contains only vowels and punctuation. The MRA algorithm: 1. Uppercases the input: "uoiea.,-AEIOU" -> "UOIEA.,-AEIOU" 2. Strips punctuation (. , -): "UOIEA.,-AEIOU" -> "UOIEAAEIOU" 3. Keeps the leading vowel but removes every other vowel: "UOIEAAEIOU" -> "U" (only the first 'U' is kept) Expected result: "U"
only the initial vowel survives encoding
